title: The Skill of Long-Term Investing
intro: A year of personal coaching in which you develop the skill of long-term investing, step by step, with an experienced investor and teacher at your side.
highlights: Weekly assignments and independent study materials
Quarterly reviews at months 3, 6, 9 and 12 (90 min)
why_text:
You want to truly understand the financial markets and master the skill of long-term investing. But the information in books, videos, personal opinions and social media is scattered, often contradictory and confusing. It does not lead to a clear strategy or a strong set of skills.

What is missing is not more information. It's a complete, professional program with an experienced coach working one-on-one with you: a seasoned investor and teacher who helps you develop a coherent skill, step by step, and gives you the clear, honest feedback you need to invest with confidence.
learn_text:
In 12 months, you learn the skill of long-term investing. You develop and defend your own investment theses, and construct a complete portfolio the way professionals do.

You learn how financial markets actually work and what makes prices move. You build a solid foundation in market knowledge, investing philosophy and psychology.

You leave with real, applied experience. In week one you open your own paper portfolio with $100,000 in starting capital: a full year of investing, analyzing and portfolio building in your own paper account.
for_points: You have explored the markets, or traded or invested a bit, and now want to turn that experience into a lasting skill
You want to aim high, and you accept that there are no guarantees
You can commit 3 to 5 hours a week, for a full year
You are willing to study, practice and receive honest feedback
notfor_title: This is not for you if
notfor_points: You are looking for signals, picks, or someone to tell you what to buy
You expect quick or guaranteed returns
You want a 30-day shortcut. This is a year-long program, and that time is exactly what builds the skill

requirements.title: Intro call
requirements.text: Every student is accepted after a personal intro call, to make sure the program is the right fit.

requirements.title: Basic market knowledge
requirements.text: You know what a stock is and what the financial markets are.

requirements.title: Tools
requirements.text: A computer with Excel or Google Sheets.

requirements.title: Language
requirements.text: You are comfortable following lessons in English.

year_intro: The program runs for 12 months in four phases. Each phase builds on the previous one, taking you from a solid foundation to full independence.

quarters.label: Month 1
quarters.title: Foundation
quarters.text: We dive deep into the playing field. You define who you are as an investor: your goals, your time horizon and your objectives. By the end, you have your first Investment Policy Statement (IPS) and your paper portfolio is up and running.

quarters.label: Months 2–5
quarters.title: Understanding businesses, the market and yourself
quarters.text: You develop rational thinking skills and learn to recognize quality businesses and competitive advantages. You lay the foundation of your circle of competence and learn to write one-page theses. By the end, you can judge whether a business is worth your time and explain why. Companies that meet your criteria go into your paper portfolio.

quarters.label: Months 6–10
quarters.title: Valuation and portfolio management
quarters.text: You learn to value a business thoroughly, manage risk, size your positions, apply various instruments and develop an in-depth specialization. Every position in your paper portfolio now has a valuation model and a margin of safety, and you defend each new position in a thesis defense.

quarters.label: Months 11–12
quarters.title: Behavior and independence
quarters.text: You develop awareness of market psychology, go deep into investment philosophy and study your own psychology with a guest investor psychologist. You write extensive sell rules and practice various portfolio types. By the end, you have finished your IPS and your personal investment plan, and you manage your paper portfolio entirely on your own.

how.title: Weekly 1:1 session (60 min)
how.text: We discuss the core chapter of the week, review last week's assignment, share the self-study material, track your paper portfolio, analyze companies on your watchlist and prepare the next assignment. Fully tailored to your progress.

how.title: Weekly independent study
how.text: A book chapter, an academic paper or memo, or a video. Additional material is available if you want to go deeper.

how.title: Weekly practical assignment
how.text: To apply what you learned right away.

how.title: Monthly exam
how.text: A questionnaire, analysis or case study that closes the month. If you don't pass, you get detailed 1:1 feedback and a second attempt.

how.title: Monthly thesis defense
how.text: You defend your monthly assignment, such as part of your IPS, a valuation model or a portfolio update. You pass when your reasoning holds up under scrutiny. If not, you get feedback and a second attempt.

how.title: Quarterly review (90 min)
how.text: Every quarter closes with a review of your progress, research process and decision journal.

how.title: Built-in flexibility
how.text: A two-week summer break, a one-week winter break and four personal flex weeks for holidays, illness, catching up or a retake.

deliverables_intro: You leave with a complete, personal investing system, usable for the rest of your life.

deliverables.title: Your Investment Policy Statement (IPS)
deliverables.text: Your personal rulebook: goals, required return, allocation, position limits, holding policy and crisis protocol, rewritten every quarter as your skills grow.

deliverables.title: Your Investment Plan
deliverables.text: How the rules get applied, week by week: your long-term plan, a crash playbook, and written sell rules for every holding.

deliverables.title: Your Spreadsheet Toolkit
deliverables.text: A personal dashboard, a discounted cash flow (DCF) model, sensitivity analysis, and simulators for position sizing, rebalancing and retirement.

deliverables.title: Your Investment Memos
deliverables.text: The written arguments behind your key decisions, from valuation packs to a letter to your future self.

deliverables.title: A Year of Real Practice
deliverables.text: Your paper portfolio and decision journal: twelve months of documented decisions, quarterly reviews, and lessons you can point to.

assessed_text: Great investors are built on great decisions, not short-term outcomes. That's why we measure what you control and what leads to results over the long term: your process, reasoning and discipline. Your monthly exams, thesis defenses and paper portfolio decisions show exactly where you stand and what to work on next.
coach_text:
I started my career as a professional trader at an Amsterdam-based proprietary trading firm. After strong results in the Peak Capital Trading bootcamp, I earned a seat at Andrew Aziz's firm, Peak Capital Trading.

Today I invest independently for the long term and teach long-term investing in a Canadian trader education program. Years of working in the markets taught me what really makes the difference: not the next big idea, but discipline, a clear process and control over your own behaviour.

faq.question: Do you guarantee returns?
faq.answer: No. The evidence says most who chase outperformance fail, and I will show you that evidence in the first month. What I commit to is the training: high-quality education, honest feedback, and 1:1 guidance in skill development. In the end, however, the market owes nobody a thing.

faq.question: Will I actually beat the market after this?
faq.answer: Maybe not, but by the end of the year you will know whether to try, and how. The skills transfer either way: understanding businesses, valuing them, managing risk and managing your own psychology pay off in your career, your business, and every financial decision you make after this program.

faq.question: Is this investment advice?
faq.answer: No. This is an education and coaching program. I teach you how to build and follow your own investing process. I never give buy, sell or hold recommendations, and all exercises take place in a paper portfolio.

faq.question: What if I fall behind?
faq.answer: Four flex weeks exist precisely for that. The program extends; it does not skip. Sequence matters more than speed.

faq.question: Why twelve months?
faq.answer: Because understanding businesses and markets, building a valuation and surviving a defense are skills, and skills take practice. In addition, the psychological layer only shows itself over months of real decisions, not in one webinar.

faq.question: What if I start and realize it's not for me?
faq.answer: You can withdraw within the first 10 days and receive 100% of your payment back.

faq.question: Is the coaching online?
faq.answer: Yes. All sessions take place online, so you can join from anywhere.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: We discuss the investment and the payment options in your intro call.
